column1: # Pinned external downloads, fetched by build_files/downloads/fetch-pinned in the
# token-only `downloads` stage and bind-mounted read-only at /downloads into the
# package stages. Columns are tab-separated: name, url, sha256, dest (relative to
# /downloads). Release assets pin a tag, raw files pin a commit; the sha256 is the
# real pin. Bump with `just bump-downloads`, review, edit.
